description: This header file declares the exported API functions for an HTTP Simple Client Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization routines.

methods.name: HttpCreateSimpleClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new instance of the HTTP Simple Client object.

methods.name: HttpScoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new HTTP Simple Client object.

methods.name: HttpScoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified HTTP Simple Client object.

methods.name: HttpScoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or components into the HTTP Simple Client object.

methods.name: HttpScoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Simple Client object.
